identity.title: Diagnostic ring code 14 and optional evidence

governance_basis.post_pin_scope: Operator approved a narrow separate owner and MT-215 adoption. Use present repository scope/resume controls where directly ordered. The approval does not re-pin WP-012 or blanket-adopt V2/HBR-HOST or later attempt counters. The source-first and exact pin below are expressly scoped by the decision and reflect current lifecycle policy without reopening old verdicts.

closure_unit.outcome: One source-only diag_ring change with independently verified canonical revision and focused standalone evidence. The unchanged host defaults and independent MT-215 adoption remain separately recorded.

materialized_acceptance.text: Append PresentStalled = 14 to the existing typed ordinary/survivable allowlist. Named constructors pair Degraded with Warn and Recovered with Info only. Document existing numeric fields: previous published beat and watched-window count, elapsed microseconds, event sequence and monotonic timestamp. No text, renumber, layout or ring-version change.

The existing V2 round-trip case proves both code 14 transitions survive the real mapped ring with correct numeric payload, zero reserved/padding fields and unchanged v1/v2 compatibility. Semantically inconsistent code 14 must not enter the typed constructor path; old unknown-code rejection remains.

Default evidence preserves the existing three-tier JSON emission/read-back, diagnostic event serde round trip and public evidence API. No-default removes evidence and serde from the standalone normal/build closure while the same focused ring round-trip still succeeds.

The six direct consumer manifests remain byte-identical and resolve with locked offline metadata. A source-only candidate with exact origin revision, subtree, Cargo.lock and toolchain digests and independent proof is ready for pinned adoption. No MT-215, MT-214, Palmistry, Core or default consumer changes in this source commit.

implementation_steps.step: Inspect current discriminants and V2 ordinary gate. Add code 14 and two typed transitions in schema.rs through the existing shared allowlist; keep ring.rs, wire version/layout and all prior codes untouched. Extend only the existing V2 round-trip test to exercise both transitions, payload and retained reject checks.

Make serde and serde_json optional behind default evidence. Gate schema derives, lib module/re-exports, evidence-only test functions and the evidence-only integration target, preserving all existing default APIs and schemas. Document feature and code fields in the existing crate rustdoc.

Run only the admitted compile/static source check and report. Commit the source-only paths, run independent named proof under the WP topology and verify the pushed origin revision independently. Do not enable adoption or rewrite prior PASS records on local proof.
